facts.fact: Africa Frontline First and Living Goods state that community health worker data are not integrated into the national health information system (DHIS2/ENDOS), most community health workers still use paper tools, and a roadmap prioritising that integration was co-created by the Ministry of Health with Africa CDC, Living Goods and UNICEF at a workshop on 8-12 September 2025, with finalisation, validation and resourcing still to come.
